method: Visual inspection of actual browser screenshots and viewport comparison sheets with view_image; combined with automated geometry and interaction checks.
additionalActualScreensInspected: Final native Edge zoom200 focused editor field and learner route
Final desktop and 360 learner CSS zoom200 header
Loaded maps at desktop, 360 and 768 after the control clearance correction
resolvedFindings: Mobile preview button and enlarged learner header wrap within the available width
Assessment action buttons wrap at 768 without page overflow
Dialog buttons are visible above the mobile navigation
Native zoom focused editor field is clear of the save bar
Loaded map controls are clear of the mobile navigation; connections remain continuous
Secondary navigation and map loading text contrast corrected
Enlarged mobile navigation labels stay within their destinations
captureFramingLimit: Some mobile viewport screenshots have an incomplete or blank framing after scrolling, notably renderer-study and renderer-sequence at 390. Their original full-page captures were inspected and show the corresponding content. Both original captures remain linked in gallery.html; no claim is made that every viewport image is optimally framed. Full-page screenshots can show fixed bars within the captured document.
limits: No human accessibility approval or full WCAG certification
Synthetic image fixture does not verify clinical illustration readability
Mobile viewport and touch emulation do not replace physical device checks
